biomarkers.name: PAX3-FOXO1 or PAX7-FOXO1 fusion
biomarkers.clinical_use: Fusion-positive ARMS has worse prognosis than fusion-negative (which behaves like ERMS). PAX3-FOXO1 is associated with worse outcome than PAX7-FOXO1

biomarkers.name: MyoD1, myogenin (MYF4)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic for rhabdomyoblastic differentiation; diffuse strong myogenin expression favours ARMS

biomarkers.name: FOXO1 break-apart FISH
biomarkers.prevalence: Detects FOXO1 rearrangement in most fusion-positive ARMS
biomarkers.clinical_use: Confirms FOXO1 rearrangement when RT-PCR or sequencing is unavailable

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small round blue cells arranged in nests separated by fibrovascular septa with central discohesion producing 'alveolar' pattern

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not well characterised in paediatric sarcomas; TIL infiltration less studied
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrovascular septa separating tumour nests; central discohesion mimicking alveolar spaces

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mesenchymal cells with skeletal muscle differentiation potential  arrested at early myoblast stage
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Rhabdomyoblastic (skeletal muscle) differentiation with variable maturation (MyoD1+, myogenin+, desmin+); undifferentiated small round blue cell appearance masks myogenic lineage
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: PAX3-FOXO1 or PAX7-FOXO1 fusion (from t(2;13) or t(1;13)) drives lineage-locking  fuses PAX3/7 to FOXO1 producing a chimeric transcription factor that maintains proliferation state and impairs terminal muscle differentiation; fusion-negative ARMS behaves biologically like embryonal RMS
